title: 液液萃取：用分液漏斗分开溶液

points.K2: 萃取：从一种溶剂搬到另一种
points.K5: 哪层在下？查密度，加水试
points.S1: 易燃溶剂：通风柜里，远离火源
points.S4: 除溶剂别用加热板敞口蒸
points.S5: 水相、有机相废液分类收

shots.scene: 欣欣站在铁架台旁，旁边的分液漏斗里有上下两层液体，欣欣招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside a ring stand holding a separatory funnel with two clear liquid layers, and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课学液液萃取。
overlay: 液液萃取：用分液漏斗分开溶液

shots.scene: 分液漏斗、两层液体、放气箭头、护目镜四个图标
shots.prompt_en: Four icons in a row: a separatory funnel, two stacked liquid layers, a small gas release arrow, and safety goggles. No people.
shots.narration: 分得清、混得匀、放得稳、守得住。

shots.scene: 阿杰拿着一瓶澄清溶液，旁边漏斗和滤纸，挠头
shots.prompt_en: The young male student holds a flask of clear solution next to a funnel with filter paper and scratches his head.
shots.narration: 阿杰想用过滤分开溶液里的两种东西。

shots.scene: 溶液直接穿过滤纸，什么也没留下
shots.prompt_en: A clear solution passes straight through filter paper, nothing remains on the paper. No people.
shots.narration: 可它们都溶着，滤纸挡不住。

shots.scene: 小研戴护目镜，举起一个分液漏斗
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student in a lab coat and goggles holds up a separatory funnel and smiles.
shots.narration: 小研说：这得用萃取。

shots.scene: 烧瓶里澄清溶液中漂浮着两种不同的分子图标
shots.prompt_en: A flask of clear solution with two different molecule icons dissolved inside. No people.
shots.narration: 组分都溶在溶液里，过滤没用。

shots.scene: 溶解度、极性、反应性三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a dissolving cube, a molecule with plus and minus ends, and a reaction spark. No people.
shots.narration: 要靠溶解度、极性、反应性来分。

shots.section_title: 萃取：从一种溶剂搬到另一种
shots.scene: 分子从一层液体跳到另一层液体的动画
shots.prompt_en: An animation-style diagram: a molecule moving from an upper liquid layer into a lower liquid layer in a funnel. No people.
shots.narration: 萃取：让目标物换一种溶剂待着。
overlay: 萃取：从一种溶剂搬到另一种

shots.section_title: 萃取：从一种溶剂搬到另一种
shots.scene: 上层有机相、下层水相两个图标
shots.prompt_en: Two stacked layer icons: an upper oily layer and a lower water layer with a water drop symbol. No people.
shots.narration: 最常见的是有机相和水相两层。

shots.scene: 油和水在瓶中分层
shots.prompt_en: A bottle with oil floating on water in two distinct layers. No people.
shots.narration: 加的新溶剂和原来的不能互溶。

shots.scene: 两种液体混成一片的图标被红叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of two liquids blending into a single cloudy layer, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 能混成一层，就分不开了。

shots.scene: 铁圈上的分液漏斗，两层液体
shots.prompt_en: A separatory funnel resting in a ring clamp, with two liquid layers of different colors. No people.
shots.narration: 分液漏斗专门分开两层液体。

shots.scene: 两层各带标注：有机溶剂加溶质、水加溶质
shots.prompt_en: A funnel diagram with the top layer marked with an oil drop icon and the bottom layer marked with a water drop icon, each holding small molecule dots. No people.
shots.narration: 一层是有机溶剂，一层是水。

shots.section_title: 哪层在下？查密度，加水试
shots.scene: 密度箭头从上指向下，水层在下
shots.prompt_en: A funnel diagram with a downward density arrow; the water layer sits at the bottom. No people.
shots.narration: 通常水更重，在下层。
overlay: 哪层在下？查密度，加水试

shots.section_title: 哪层在下？查密度，加水试
shots.scene: 另一个漏斗中有机层在下面，旁边感叹号
shots.prompt_en: Another funnel diagram where the organic layer sits at the bottom, with an exclamation mark. No people.
shots.narration: 可有的有机溶剂比水重，会沉底。

shots.section_title: 哪层在下？查密度，加水试
shots.scene: 小研翻看一张空白的密度表
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student checks a blank density table on a clipboard.
shots.narration: 先查密度表，心里有数。

shots.section_title: 哪层在下？查密度，加水试
shots.scene: 加几滴水后，下层液面升高
shots.prompt_en: A few drops of water added to a separatory funnel; the bottom layer visibly grows. No people.
shots.narration: 拿不准就加点水，变多的是水层。

shots.scene: 分液漏斗特写：顶部塞子、底部活塞
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of a separatory funnel: stopper at the top and stopcock at the bottom highlighted. No people.
shots.narration: 上有塞子，下有活塞，中间分层。

shots.scene: 小研在活塞上薄薄涂一点润滑脂
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student applies a thin film of grease to the stopcock of a separatory funnel.
shots.narration: 容易卡住，就涂一点润滑脂。

shots.scene: 老周把铁圈固定在铁架台上，放入分液漏斗
shots.prompt_en: The older man in a lab coat and goggles fixes a ring clamp to a stand and sets the separatory funnel into it.
shots.narration: 铁圈装好，漏斗放进去，确认稳固。

shots.scene: 关着活塞的漏斗装着清水，活塞处无渗漏
shots.prompt_en: A separatory funnel with closed stopcock holding clean water; the stopcock is dry with no drips. No people.
shots.narration: 先装点水，关着活塞看漏不漏。

shots.scene: 打开活塞，水顺畅流入烧杯
shots.prompt_en: The stopcock is opened and water flows smoothly into a beaker below. No people.
shots.narration: 再打开活塞，看流得顺不顺。

shots.scene: 老周把试漏的水倒掉，竖起大拇指
shots.prompt_en: The older man empties the test water and gives a thumbs up.
shots.narration: 没问题，倒掉水，准备开始。

shots.scene: 反应烧瓶在冷浴中，加入一勺水的图标
shots.prompt_en: A reaction flask in a cold bath with an icon of water being added and a stop sign. No people.
shots.narration: 反应做完，常要加水淬灭。

shots.scene: 停止标志旁有弱酸弱碱瓶子，标签空白
shots.prompt_en: A stop sign icon next to two small bottles with blank labels and mild acid and base pictograms. No people.
shots.narration: 让反应停下，中和离子性物质。

shots.scene: 反应烧瓶到分液漏斗的箭头
shots.prompt_en: An arrow from a reaction flask to a separatory funnel. No people.
shots.narration: 所以反应之后，几乎都要萃取。

shots.scene: 烧杯里两种分子A和B都溶在有机溶剂中
shots.prompt_en: A beaker of organic solvent with two molecule icons A and B dissolved, both marked as insoluble in water with a crossed water drop. No people.
shots.narration: 这里两种有机物都溶在有机溶剂里。

shots.scene: 碱液加入后，A分子带上负电荷
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a base drop added; molecule A gains a negative charge symbol. No people.
shots.narration: 加入碱水，有机酸变成带电的盐。

shots.scene: 带电的A进入水层，B留在有机层
shots.prompt_en: A funnel diagram: charged molecule A moves to the lower water layer, neutral molecule B stays in the upper organic layer. No people.
shots.narration: 盐溶于水跑进水层，另一个留下。

shots.scene: 小研检查活塞已关闭
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student checks that the stopcock is in the closed position.
shots.narration: 先确认活塞关着。

shots.scene: 小研用玻璃漏斗把溶液倒入分液漏斗
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student pours the solution into the separatory funnel through a small glass funnel.
shots.narration: 用小漏斗把溶液倒进去。

shots.scene: 小研用少量溶剂冲洗烧杯，一并倒入
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student rinses the empty beaker with a little solvent and adds the rinse to the funnel.
shots.narration: 原烧杯再冲一冲，一点不浪费。

shots.scene: 小研把碱溶液经漏斗加进分液漏斗
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student adds a basic solution with a blank label into the separatory funnel through a small funnel.
shots.narration: 直接在漏斗里加入碱溶液。

shots.scene: 碱液穿过上层，在下面形成新水层，箭头标出
shots.prompt_en: A diagram: drops of base solution sinking through the upper layer and forming a new lower water layer, with arrows. No people.
shots.narration: 碱液穿过有机层，边走边反应。

shots.scene: 生成的盐被带进下层
shots.prompt_en: Small charged molecule icons carried down into the lower water layer. No people.
shots.narration: 生成的盐，被带进下面的水层。

shots.scene: 小研一手按住塞子，把漏斗倒过来
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student holds the stopper firmly with one hand and turns the separatory funnel upside down.
shots.narration: 手按住塞子，把漏斗倒过来。

shots.scene: 小研轻轻旋摇倒置的漏斗
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student gently swirls the inverted funnel a few times.
shots.narration: 轻轻旋摇几下，让两层充分接触。

shots.scene: 倒置的漏斗打开活塞放气，放气口朝向通风柜里面
shots.prompt_en: The inverted funnel with its stopcock opened, the tip pointing toward the back of a fume hood, a small puff of gas released. No people.
shots.narration: 倒着打开活塞，把气放掉。

shots.scene: 关上活塞继续摇，声波图标逐渐消失
shots.prompt_en: Repeating cycle icons: shake, vent, shake, with a hissing sound wave icon getting smaller each time. No people.
shots.narration: 关上再摇，再放，一轮一轮来。

shots.scene: 耳朵图标旁的嘶嘶声消失，绿勾
shots.prompt_en: An ear icon next to a silent sound wave with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 听不到嘶嘶声，就混合好了。

shots.scene: 漏斗放回铁圈，取下塞子，两层慢慢分开
shots.prompt_en: The separatory funnel back in the ring with its stopper removed; two layers slowly separate. No people.
shots.narration: 放回铁圈，取下塞子，静置分层。

shots.scene: 打开活塞，下层流入干净锥形瓶
shots.prompt_en: The stopcock is opened and the lower layer flows into a clean conical flask with a blank label. No people.
shots.narration: 打开活塞，下层流进干净的瓶子。

shots.scene: 小研蹲下平视界面，手放在活塞上
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student crouches to watch the interface at eye level with her hand on the stopcock.
shots.narration: 这一步要盯紧，让液体慢慢滴。

shots.scene: 界面到达活塞处，活塞关闭，绿勾
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: the boundary between layers reaches the stopcock and the stopcock is turned closed, green check. No people.
shots.narration: 分界线一到活塞，马上关。

shots.scene: 小研从漏斗上口把上层倒进另一个瓶子
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student pours the upper layer out through the top opening of the funnel into another flask.
shots.narration: 上层从上口倒出来。

shots.scene: 上层从活塞放出的图标被红叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of the upper layer being drained out through the stopcock, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 从下面放，会沾上残留的下层。

shots.scene: 有机层倒回漏斗，再加碱液
shots.prompt_en: The organic layer is poured back into the separatory funnel and more basic solution is added. No people.
shots.narration: 一次萃不干净，倒回去再来一次。

shots.scene: 重复的混合、放气、分层图标
shots.prompt_en: Cycle icons of mixing, venting and separating repeated twice. No people.
shots.narration: 同样混合、放气、分层。

shots.scene: 两次放出的下层倒入同一个瓶子
shots.prompt_en: Two portions of the lower layer being combined into one flask. No people.
shots.narration: 两次的水层合在一起，收率更高。

shots.scene: 有机层瓶里有细小水珠
shots.prompt_en: A flask of organic layer with tiny water droplets visible inside. No people.
shots.narration: 有机层里还残留着水。

shots.scene: 小研用药匙加入白色颗粒干燥剂
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student adds white granular drying agent from a bottle with a blank label into the flask with a spatula.
shots.narration: 加干燥剂，把水吸到固体里。

shots.scene: 溶液澄清，干燥剂结块沉底；轻摇后颗粒不再游动
shots.prompt_en: Two panels: clumped drying agent at the bottom of a clear solution, and after a gentle swirl no loose particles moving. No people.
shots.narration: 溶液清了，摇一摇不再有游动颗粒。

shots.scene: 铁圈上的漏斗过滤有机层，干燥剂留在滤纸上
shots.prompt_en: A funnel with filter paper in a ring filtering the organic layer; drying agent stays on the paper. No people.
shots.narration: 常压过滤，把干燥剂滤掉。

shots.scene: 小研用溶剂冲洗瓶子，倒入漏斗
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student rinses the flask with a little solvent and pours it into the funnel.
shots.narration: 瓶子再冲一次，转移干净。

shots.scene: 通风柜里的旋转蒸发仪，烧瓶在温水浴中旋转
shots.prompt_en: A rotary evaporator inside a fume hood with its flask rotating in a warm water bath. No people.
shots.narration: 除去溶剂，剩下的就是产物B。

shots.scene: 烧瓶底部一层白色固体
shots.prompt_en: A round-bottom flask with a thin white solid residue at the bottom. No people.
shots.narration: 中性的那种物质，就分离出来了。

shots.scene: 水层瓶子，里面是溶解的盐
shots.prompt_en: A flask labeled with a blank tag holding the combined water layer with dissolved salt icons. No people.
shots.narration: 水层里的是盐，还要变回有机酸。

shots.scene: 小研在通风柜里慢慢滴加酸液，边加边摇
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student slowly adds acid from a dropper into the flask inside a fume hood, swirling gently.
shots.narration: 慢慢加酸，边加边摇。

shots.scene: 玻璃棒蘸溶液点在试纸上，试纸变成酸性颜色
shots.prompt_en: A glass rod touching a drop of solution onto pH test paper, which turns to an acidic color. No people.
shots.narration: 用试纸检查，显酸性说明加够了。

shots.scene: 瓶中出现白色浑浊沉淀
shots.prompt_en: White cloudy precipitate forming in the flask. No people.
shots.narration: 有机酸重新生成，析出白色沉淀。

shots.scene: 瓶子放进冰水浴
shots.prompt_en: The flask placed in a bowl of ice water. No people.
shots.narration: 析出太慢，就放进冰水浴。

shots.scene: 减压过滤装置收集白色固体
shots.prompt_en: A vacuum filtration setup with white solid collecting on the filter paper in a Buchner funnel. No people.
shots.narration: 用减压过滤把固体收集起来。

shots.scene: 表面皿上的白色固体，旁边烘箱图标
shots.prompt_en: A watch glass with white powder on a bench next to a drying oven icon. No people.
shots.narration: 先晾干，需要时再放进烘箱。

shots.scene: 两瓶产物：一瓶有机酸、一瓶中性物质，欣欣举起
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up two small vials of white solids with blank labels, one in each hand.
shots.narration: 一个靠酸碱性，两种物质就分开了。

shots.scene: 茶叶和咖啡杯图标，矿石和金属锭图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of tea leaves and a coffee cup, and icons of a rock ore and a metal ingot. No people.
shots.narration: 工业上也用萃取提取天然产物和金属。

shots.scene: 实验室中多个分液漏斗排成一排
shots.prompt_en: A row of separatory funnels on ring stands in a teaching lab. No people.
shots.narration: 有机化学里，萃取天天用得上。

shots.section_title: 易燃溶剂：通风柜里，远离火源
shots.scene: 易燃液体标志的溶剂瓶在通风柜里
shots.prompt_en: A solvent bottle with a flammable liquid hazard pictogram standing inside a fume hood with the sash lowered. No people.
shots.narration: 萃取常用易燃溶剂，放在通风柜里做。
overlay: 易燃溶剂：通风柜里，远离火源

shots.section_title: 易燃溶剂：通风柜里，远离火源
shots.scene: 溶剂蒸气沿台面流向远处火焰的图标被红叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of heavy solvent vapor creeping along a bench toward a distant flame, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 蒸气会贴着台面跑，附近不能有火。

shots.section_title: 易燃溶剂：通风柜里，远离火源
shots.scene: 王老师指着通风柜外的加热板和插座，示意移开
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator points at a hot plate and a power socket near the fume hood, signaling to move them away.
shots.narration: 加热板、电火花也要远离。

shots.section_title: 易燃溶剂：通风柜里，远离火源
shots.scene: 易燃品柜里整齐放着溶剂瓶，标签空白
shots.prompt_en: Solvent bottles with blank labels stored neatly in a yellow flammable storage cabinet with a flammable sign. No people.
shots.narration: 用完盖紧，放回易燃品柜。

shots.section_title: 易燃溶剂：通风柜里，远离火源
shots.scene: 旧溶剂瓶上的日历图标和警示三角
shots.prompt_en: An old solvent bottle with a calendar icon and a yellow warning triangle beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 久放的乙醚类溶剂，按规定检查处置。

shots.scene: 放气时漏斗出口对着同学的图标被红叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of an inverted funnel venting toward another person's face, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 放气时，出口别对着人。

shots.scene: 小研在通风柜里放气，出口朝向柜内后方
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student vents the inverted funnel inside a fume hood, the tip pointing toward the back of the hood away from everyone.
shots.narration: 朝着通风柜里面放。

shots.scene: 塞子冲出的图标，旁边警示三角
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a stopper popping out of a funnel under pressure, with a yellow warning triangle. No people.
shots.narration: 不及时放气，塞子可能被顶出来。

shots.scene: 第一次摇动就放气的时间轴图标
shots.prompt_en: A timeline icon: a gentle first shake immediately followed by a vent symbol. No people.
shots.narration: 头几下摇得轻，放气要勤。

shots.scene: 腐蚀性标志的酸瓶和碱瓶，标签空白
shots.prompt_en: An acid bottle and a base bottle with blank labels, both bearing the corrosive hazard pictogram. No people.
shots.narration: 酸和碱都有腐蚀性。

shots.scene: 小研戴护目镜和手套，在通风柜里加酸
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student in goggles, lab coat and gloves adds acid slowly inside a fume hood.
shots.narration: 戴好护目镜和手套，慢慢加。

shots.scene: 阿杰在水槽用大量流水冲洗手臂
shots.prompt_en: The young male student rinses his forearm under a stream of running water at a lab sink.
shots.narration: 溅到皮肤，立即用大量流水冲洗。

shots.scene: 洗眼器标志和正在出水的洗眼器
shots.prompt_en: An eyewash sign above a lab eyewash station with water flowing. No people.
shots.narration: 溅进眼睛，马上到洗眼器冲洗。

shots.scene: 阿杰向老周报告，电话图标旁有红十字
shots.prompt_en: The young male student reports to the older man; a telephone icon with a red cross appears beside them.
shots.narration: 报告老师，需要时拨打120就医。

shots.section_title: 除溶剂别用加热板敞口蒸
shots.scene: 易燃溶剂放在加热板上敞口蒸发的图标被红叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of an open flask of flammable solvent sitting directly on a hot plate, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 易燃溶剂，别放加热板上敞口蒸。
overlay: 除溶剂别用加热板敞口蒸

shots.section_title: 除溶剂别用加热板敞口蒸
shots.scene: 通风柜里的旋转蒸发仪，温水浴
shots.prompt_en: A rotary evaporator with a warm water bath inside a fume hood with the sash lowered. No people.
shots.narration: 用旋转蒸发仪，在通风柜里除溶剂。

shots.section_title: 除溶剂别用加热板敞口蒸
shots.scene: 蒸干的烧瓶图标被红叉，留少量液体的烧瓶打勾
shots.prompt_en: Two icons: a completely dry flask with a red X, and a flask with a little liquid left with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 不要蒸到干透，按讲义操作。

shots.section_title: 水相、有机相废液分类收
shots.scene: 废液倒进水槽的图标被红叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of waste liquid being poured into a sink drain, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 萃取剩下的液体，不能倒水槽。
overlay: 水相、有机相废液分类收

shots.section_title: 水相、有机相废液分类收
shots.scene: 两个标签空白的废液桶：有机废液、水相废液
shots.prompt_en: Two waste containers with blank labels side by side, one with an organic solvent icon and one with a water drop icon. No people.
shots.narration: 有机废液和水相废液分开收集。

shots.section_title: 水相、有机相废液分类收
shots.scene: 用过的干燥剂和滤纸进固体废物桶
shots.prompt_en: Used drying agent and filter paper going into a solid chemical waste bin with a blank label. No people.
shots.narration: 用过的干燥剂、滤纸进固体废物桶。

shots.section_title: 水相、有机相废液分类收
shots.scene: 小研在废液登记本上记录，王老师在旁
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student writes in a blank waste log sheet while the safety administrator watches.
shots.narration: 盖好桶盖，做好登记。

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮现分液漏斗和两层液体图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside floating icons of a separatory funnel and two liquid layers.
shots.narration: 不互溶才分层，拿不准加水试。

shots.scene: 试漏、倒置混合、放气三个打勾图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons with green checks: a leak test, an inverted funnel being shaken, and a venting funnel. No people.
shots.narration: 先试漏，按住塞子摇，及时放气。

shots.scene: 下层从活塞放、上层从上口倒的图标
shots.prompt_en: Two icons: lower layer drained through the stopcock, upper layer poured from the top. No people.
shots.narration: 下层下面放，上层上口倒。

shots.scene: 通风柜、洗眼器、废液桶三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a fume hood, an eyewash station and two waste containers. No people.
shots.narration: 通风柜里做，远离火源，废液分类。

shots.scene: 欣欣举着分液漏斗挥手道别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds a separatory funnel and waves goodbye at the camera.
shots.narration: 分得清，做得稳，下次见！
